messages.footer-description: Hot-reloadable Kotlin scripting for Minecraft Paper, Fabric, NeoForge, and Velocity.
messages.hero-subtitle: Hot-reloadable Kotlin scripts (.mkot.kts) with a mutable, cross-platform gameplay API for Paper, Fabric, NeoForge, and Velocity.
messages.feature-hotreload-desc: Edit a script and reload it on the fly without stopping the server. Your workflow stays uninterrupted.
messages.feature-brigadier-desc: Well-crafted wrappers for commands, events, scheduling, and more, plus exposed storage, so you never write boilerplate or glue again.
messages.feature-adapters-desc: One script runs everywhere: Paper, Fabric, NeoForge, and Velocity. Platform adapters handle the differences so you don't have to.
messages.feature-isolation-desc: Side isolation and the capability system keep client and server code separated and make unsupported features fail safely, not catastrophically.
messages.feature-capability-desc: Friendly DSLs, clear error messages, and sensible defaults. Write a working script in minutes without studying the platform.
messages.feature-storage-desc: Powered by Kotlin coroutines for non-blocking, concurrent execution that scales with your network instead of blocking the main thread.
messages.platforms-note: Platform versions represent the minimum verified release. Active compatibility is maintained for newer server and proxy builds.
messages.simulator-subtitle: Edit the script, run it, then simulate a player join or type a command to watch MineKot react.
messages.simulator-sim-note: This demo is fully simulated and only partially implemented. Not every feature is included yet, and some actions may produce errors.
messages.console-cmd-version: MineKot demo runtime 1.0.0, fully simulated in your browser.
messages.console-cmd-help: Commands: /say <text>, /echo <text>, /time, /who, /version, /ping, /minekot (/mkot) <sub>, /clear, /help. Script commands activate when a script is loaded.
messages.console-cmd-unknown: Unknown command: /{command}. Type /help for available commands.
messages.minekot-help-line-list: list - Show loaded and unloaded scripts
messages.minekot-error-unknown-sub: Unknown subcommand: {sub}. Type /minekot help for usage.
messages.minekot-error-extension: {file} is not a MineKot script. Scripts use the .mkot.kts extension.
messages.minekot-error-not-found: File not found: scripts/{file}. The editor holds {available}.
messages.minekot-error-already-loaded: {file} is already loaded. Use /minekot reload {file} instead.
messages.minekot-error-not-loaded: {file} is not loaded. Load it first with /minekot load {file}.
messages.log-init: MineKot runtime initialized. Click 'Run Script' to execute hot reload.
messages.log-join-warn: {player} attempted to join but no script has been hot-loaded yet.
messages.log-join-disabled: {player} triggered MKPlayerJoinEvent but script {name} is disabled.
messages.log-join-no-handler: [{name}] No MKPlayerJoinEvent handler found in the script.
messages.log-cmd-warn: {player} issued command /{command} but no script has been hot-loaded yet.
messages.log-cmd-disabled: {player} issued command /{command} but script {name} is disabled.
messages.log-cmd-unregistered: {player} issued command /{command} but command is unregistered.
messages.about-lead: MineKot is a Kotlin scripting engine for Minecraft networks. It combines hot-reloadable .mkot.kts scripts with a mutable, cross-platform gameplay API for Paper, Fabric, NeoForge, and Velocity.
messages.about-design-rule-1: Public scripts depend on MineKot types, not loader classes.
messages.about-design-rule-2: APIs are rich and mutable where Minecraft safely permits mutation.
messages.about-design-rule-3: Unsupported operations report capabilities or typed results instead of silently pretending to work.
messages.about-design-rule-4: Native handles are escape hatches, not cross-platform contracts.
messages.about-design-rule-5: Each Minecraft line gets its own tested adapter and artifact.
messages.about-design-rule-6: Tests focus on behavior with failure risk: lifecycle cleanup, scheduling, events, parsers, registries, resolution, and mutable state.
messages.community-lead: MineKot is built in the open. Contributions, issues, and feedback all happen on GitHub.
messages.community-card-discord-desc: Chat, get help, and discuss development.
messages.platform-paper-status: Production-ready server adapter supporting events, scheduler, and player management.
messages.platform-fabric-status: Lightweight modded server & client scripting adapter with compile-time side safety.
messages.platform-neoforge-status: Modern modded environment support using the unified capability registry.
messages.platform-velocity-status: High-performance proxy adapter with cross-server scripting and messaging channels.
